utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting up soon—sounds like folks are pulling together pretty well. Want me to pass along the details when I get them?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please do—can you confirm the date and where it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the date or location yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep an eye out too, if I don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep reminding folks and pass along the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I come by for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Around 10 would be great — I should be back by then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll swing by around 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help where I can—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few tools, some screws, and extra paint for the porch and fence repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some screws and check if I’ve got any spare paint at home. If you tell me what tools are still missing, I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive need me to show up, and should I work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be great—could you aim for 3:30, after school pickup? If that’s tricky, we can work around your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me after pickup—I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you want to start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m thinking we start Saturday morning and just see what needs fixing first. I might need a reminder on the exact time, but I’ll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me—let’s say 9 a.m. at my place, and I’ll make a simple list so we can start with the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Pia wants, I can also invite a few more neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks—just please keep it simple so we don’t end up with too many people and not enough supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll keep it small and only invite a few trusted neighbors. I’ll let you know who I bring in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard folks are still gathering donations for the repair drive—do you know what they still need most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly tools, sturdy tarps, and a few more volunteers for pickup and sorting. I can check the list and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Rosa—just let me know what’s still missing. I can spread the word if there’s a gap.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I have everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll send you the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the details before doing anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — even a small hand helps. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if anything low-key comes up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just text me if you need me, and I’ll swing by quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Gus — do you have a hammer, a screwdriver set, and maybe a tape measure?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got all three — hammer, screwdriver set, and a tape measure. I can bring them by whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive locations and details as we go. If you want, I can help sort out where things are happening next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d help — just point me to the next place and I’ll swing by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the next stop is the community center on Maple, and then I’ve got the hardware store after that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if we’re short on tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just let me know what you’re short on, and I’ll see what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything is going first. If we can keep the drop-off simple, that would make me feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — if you can share the timing and the exact drop-off spot, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help bridge the groups and keep the repair drive moving. What’s the main thing you want me to share with everyone?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Please let everyone know we’re focusing on tools, volunteer shifts, and keeping the sign-up list updated. I’ll bring the first round of supplies, and it’d be great if you could help coordinate the check-ins.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’ll spread the word about tools, shifts, and the updated sign-up list, and I’ll handle the check-ins too. Thanks for bringing the first supplies; that’ll help us get started smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I usually end up joining late, but I’ll check in and help with whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll tell you the moment I spot anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools and donations. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the exact date and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess — I’d really appreciate you keeping an ear out. With school pickups and all, having the date and needs ahead of time will help me plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the date and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 10 a.m. at the community center — I’ll send out a reminder too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated items and label anything that needs a quick fix?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and flag anything that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in—what time should I tell folks to show up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m just getting the word through secondhand, but I’d tell folks to come by around 10 a.m. and we can sort the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word for 10 a.m. and tell everyone to bring whatever tools they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive locations for you—where should I note the first stop?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Please note the first stop at my place, and then we can go in order from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted your place as the first stop, and I’ll keep the rest in order from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, do you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — could you bring a box of tape and some markers? If that’s too much, just the markers will help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring the markers and a box of tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to check on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — if you spot anyone dropping off tools or spare parts, could you let me know? I’m trying to keep track, but I might forget a thing or two.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or spare parts and let you know right away if I see anything. আশা?
